{
  "project": "hive-research-gpu",
  "what_building": "A GPU-accelerated research assistant that synthesizes academic literature into structured summaries and knowledge graphs. It specifically focuses on complex topics like multi-agent systems and reinforcement learning by processing paper sections and figures.",
  "pipeline": [
    "ingest_paper",
    "extract_sections",
    "summarize_section",
    "generate_search_queries",
    "synthesize_answer"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "paper_title",
    "paper_content",
    "numbered_context_excerpts",
    "research_question"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "research_briefing",
    "section_summaries",
    "json_search_queries",
    "cited_claims"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.92,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "Title: {{paper_title}}",
    "Answer using ONLY the numbered context excerpts provided. Cite every claim with its excerpt number like [1] or [2][5].",
    "List up to 3 specific information gaps as refined arXiv-style search queries. Return JSON: {\"queries\": [\"...\"]}",
    "Write a thorough research briefing on: Summarize the state of multi-agent debat"
  ]
}
